name: Zoho Billing
summary: Zoho Billing charges a flat fee per organization. Premium, the first plan with subscriptions, dunning and MRR reports, costs $59 a month on annual billing or $69 monthly for up to 10 users, and works with Stripe, PayPal, Braintree and other gateways.

facts.text: Subscription billing, proration, dunning and the MRR and churn reports are on Premium and Enterprise, not on Standard.
Dunning allows up to 3 payment retries, all within 30 days.
Zoho Billing stores only the last four digits of a card, and full card details stay with the payment gateway.
Standard and Premium allow up to 100,000 invoices a year and $1 million in billed revenue a year.
Enterprise costs $5,988 a year and adds a 0.2% fee on revenue above $500,000 a month for US accounts.
Zoho runs country editions with local prices. The figures here come from the US edition, which a visitor's location does not change.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Billed annually; $29 on monthly billing. One-time invoicing for 3 users, without subscription billing

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; $69 on monthly billing. Subscriptions, proration, dunning, usage billing and MRR reports for up to 10 users

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually. Plus 0.2% of revenue above $500,000 a month for US accounts

hiddenCosts: Extra users cost $7.50 a month each on annual billing or $9 monthly.
Payment gateway fees are charged separately by the gateway.
Above 100,000 invoices or $1 million in billed revenue a year, Standard and Premium need a custom arrangement.

security.ssoPlan: SAML for the customer portal on Premium; staff SAML through Zoho Accounts

contract.cancellation: Renewal stops only with notice at least seven days before the renewal date. Refunds are possible in the first month of a monthly plan or the first 45 days of an annual plan.
contract.dataExport: Customers, subscriptions and invoices as CSV, XLS or XLSX, up to 25,000 rows per export.
